messages.text: Congratulations! You have been admitted to UCIS University. Report to the Porter's Lodge at the main gate on arrival.
Have you reached safely? Call me when you settle.
And eat something proper. Not only indomie. 🙏🏾
Water is coming at 5am. Fill your buckets tonight 🪣
Hall meeting Friday 7pm. Attendance is compulsory (it isn't).
Also: Past Questions 🔥 group is open for freshers. DM me 😉
Good morning {name}. A young man is at the main gate asking for whoever is in A-214. He says he left a phone behind. Come when you are free.
He is waiting outside. He cannot come in.
It's me. Thank you for today, {name}.
The photos are still on it. My grandmother's last birthday. 🙏🏾
Remember what I said. Anything of mine in that room — not Admin. Not anybody.
